items.title: Credo Technology Group Holding (CRDO) Secures OCP Approval For Two Optical Telemetry Standards
items.summary: Credo Technology Group Holding (NasdaqGS:CRDO) and Oracle secured OCP Community approval for two new optical telemetry specifications. The open standards cover transceiver telemetry collection and event logging designed to support AI network reliability. Both specifications are intended to encourage broader industry use of consistent monitoring across optical modules used in AI fabrics. items.title: AMD earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) reported FQ3 2026 on Nov 3. Revenue was $13.38B against a $13.06B estimate, and EPS was $2.09 against $1.94 (+7.7%). Even so, the stock traded at $487.08 (+0.66%) as of Nov 4, 12:25 PM EST. The after-hours print of $518.99 (+7.25%) has faded. The stock is down 15.8% over the past week and 23.2% over the past month, and it sits well below its 52-week high of $658.52. The market had already priced in a strong quarter.
